canon:
PROJECT: Modern Mythology — a literary visual novel across seven volumes, each volume its own time, place, and mood. The score is restrained, mostly ambient, made of held tones and texture rather than melody. Drums are rare and quiet. Vocals never. The album sits between Disasterpeace, Jeremy Soule's quieter pieces, Ben Lukas Boysen, and field-recorded location ambiences.

════════ PROJECT SONIC CANON ════════

VOLUME COLORS (each volume gets a distinct sonic register):
  · vol 0 — Title: a single suspended pad, the Modern Mythology theme.
  · vol 1 — The Diner at the Crossroads: warm-amber lounge ambient, late-night radio static, club-thud transitions.
  · vol 2 — Small Wood Volumes: pine-wind drones, rural-Appalachian field tones, distant water.
  · vol 3 — The Earthman Chronicles: glass-and-metal industrial hum, near-silent vacuum.
  · vol 4 — #/Sharp: rough analog tape hiss, basement amp buzz, lo-fi noise.
  · vol 5 — Major Arcana: D'Ambrosio's diner ambient + four arcana ambients (cicadas/Priestess, riverboat/Empress, warehouse/Magician, after-hours piano). Tarot Gauntlet jukebox B-sides per scenario (sinking-feeling afternoon, watch-party 9:30, blow-out-the-candles full moon). Magician demon-roster micro-motifs (vagrant/cicada/moth/steamboat/weir/filly/starling/husk — each a recurring textural signature, no melody). Steamboat doom-clock motif that thickens across the Magician run. Finale stingers, one per loss reason. Cameo character themes for the cathedral roster.
  · vol 6 — Planned Community: corporate-HVAC cleanliness, 68°F sine pads, no human warmth.
  · vol 7 — Land of Milk & Honey: pastoral rain-on-roof, kitchen-fire crackle, German hymn fragments.

PRODUCTION TONE
  · Loops naturally — first and last 2 seconds match.
  · No drops, no swells beyond the texture's natural breathing.
  · Field-recording layer present in every track (rain / room / wind / fluorescent / cicadas / fluorescent buzz).
  · Master at -16 LUFS. No loudness war. Tracks should sit under dialogue.
  · No drums on AMBIENT tracks. Soft brush kick is OK on a vol1 club thud and a vol5 jukebox B-side.
  · No vocals on any track. Whispered murmur as field-recording is fine.

HARD RULES
  · NO COMMERCIAL POP STRUCTURE. No verse/chorus/verse. No build-drop.
  · NO BIG ORCHESTRAL HITS. The score is intimate, not cinematic.
  · NO HAPPY MAJOR-KEY UPLIFT. Even the resolved cues stay melancholy.
  · Length: 90–180 seconds, loopable, exported as OGG.

volume_brief.0: Single suspended ambient pad. Held tone. No melody. Sit under the title card.
volume_brief.1: Warm amber. Late-night diner. Distant radio static. Low pad + room tone. Mid-period Tindersticks, plus field-recording diner ambience.
volume_brief.2: Pine wind, rural Appalachian openness, distant water. Held drone with the natural sway of outdoor air. Briar Falls or Seagash texture.
volume_brief.3: Industrial hum, near-vacuum. Glass and metal sustains. The breath of a closed system — Station Omega.
volume_brief.4: Tape hiss, amp buzz, lo-fi. Basement noise floor. Five AM nobody-around silence with mechanical noise underneath.
volume_brief.5: Diner / arcana texture. Fluorescent buzz, clock tick, brass call bell tone in the room. Late 1990s, riverboat-style diner architecture. Magician chapter adds: rust-and-code cathedral drone, river-bank pressure, cassette-deck spool, paddle-wheel doom-clock that builds across a run. Demon micro-motifs are textural signatures (a flutter, a rasp, a rumble), never melodies. Finale stingers are 30–60s and never resolve.
volume_brief.6: Corporate HVAC. 68°F sine pad. Cleanliness without warmth. The Planned Community's enforced calm.
volume_brief.7: Pastoral. Rain on a roof. Kitchen fire crackle. A German hymn fragment heard from another room. Bread on the table.
